Man Dies After Tiger Encounter at Yorkshire Wildlife Park

A man has died following an incident involving a tiger at Yorkshire Wildlife Park. Police are investigating the circumstances surrounding the death, and the local council has launched its own investigation. A witness who saw the event was reportedly distressed.
